title: cost-centre spend dashboard
source: notes warrant-layer/benchmark-design.md §1, A1 (2026-11-25); GR2 revised 2026-11-26 after batch 1
output: Per turn, a design: the components, the rules each rests on, the SQL per component, and caveats.

turns.text: Build a dashboard so cost-centre managers can see their spend against their cap and the pipeline of pending requests.
turns.example: As a worked example, give each component's figures for cost centre cc0049.

turns.text: Managers of parent centres want the same view. or filter / select the centres they want to see
turns.example: Give the figures for cc0009 (the parent of cc0049), and for a selection of cc0009 and cc0049 together.

turns.text: Finance wants the view as it stood at the end of July 2026.
turns.example: Give the approval limit of a manager and the cost centre of employee e077 as they stood then.

gold.text: Booked total rolls up over the subtree; it is semi-additive across the hierarchy: never add a parent's and its children's totals
Headroom is cap minus booked total and is not additive into a budget: a sum over centres is bounded by their ancestors' caps, and over overlapping subtrees it double-counts
A request can breach a parent's cap while its own centre still has headroom: the cap check runs against the requester's centre and every ancestor
"Committed spend" is not defined: finance has not decided whether pending requests count. Show both readings or refuse the label; do not pick one silently
The approval limit that governs a request is the version valid on the request date, not today's
Vendor status is taken on the request date; emergency requests pass despite a suspended vendor
Software requests under 10,000 are approved automatically, without the other checks; show them as their own segment
A request both denied and approved is a conflict (R314): show it as contested; it must not be counted in an approved total
Employee cost centre: hr and finance disagree for e077; finance prevails by R313. Use finance's mapping, and show the dispute where R313 does not apply
A mid-year transfer (e077, cc0077 → cc0078): which centre a request counts for depends on the date
Booked totals are declared complete (C10); pending-pipeline figures rest on known facts only: label them
All dated policy needs an "as of" parameter; a period-end view is not today's view with a filter
A selection of centres is totalled over the union of their subtrees, not by adding their totals: a parent and its child selected together must not double-count

checks.component: pending requests of cc0049 that breach a cap
booked total of the selection cc0009 + cc0049
pending requests of cc0009 that breach a cap
committed spend of cc0049, reading 1: booked total only
committed spend of cc0049, reading 2: booked total plus pending exposure
approval limit of a manager at the end of July 2026
cost centre of e077 at the end of July 2026
